description: Redux reducer module for managing channel view states in Mattermost, including post visibility, last viewed times, loading states, focused posts, mobile view, unread channels, post timestamps, toast status, and prefetch status.

methods.name: postVisibility
methods.description: Manages the visibility state of posts per channel, handling channel selection, post visibility increase, new post reception, and logout reset.

methods.name: lastChannelViewTime
methods.description: Tracks the last viewed time for each channel, updating on channel selection, last viewed time update, unread status, and logout.

methods.name: loadingPosts
methods.description: Tracks loading state of posts per channel, updating on load start and reset on logout.

methods.name: focusedPostId
methods.description: Stores the ID of the currently focused post, updating on focus reception, channel selection, and logout.

methods.name: mobileView
methods.description: Boolean indicating if the mobile view is active, updated via actions.

methods.name: lastUnreadChannel
methods.description: Tracks if the current channel was unread and had mentions when switched to, resets on leaving the channel or logout.

methods.name: lastGetPosts
methods.description: Records the timestamp of the last received posts for each channel, updating on receipt and resetting on logout.

methods.name: toastStatus
methods.description: Boolean indicating toast notification status, toggled on specific actions and reset on logout.

methods.name: channelPrefetchStatus
methods.description: Tracks prefetch status for channels, updating on prefetch actions and resetting on websocket failure/closure or logout.
